$schema_note: Deterministic structure of a NEW-SYSTEM (data-mx) Versus. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — consumed by validate-chapter-plan.py (mx-special checks, WP-6) and scripts/stitch_specials.py. Chrome is stitcher-owned and writer-unrepresentable. Spec: design-system-unification SPEC Part 1 (Law 5: verdict stamp slams per round), Part 7 §3 (Versus = criteria-first + per-round verdicts + committed conditional verdict), WP-6.

law2.planned_density_note: Same reachability model as season-review.json: est_screens_390 = words/250 + 0.5 x total_planned_events (writer events + stitcher structural: plates = n_chapters, act openers = n_acts, transits = n_acts - 1); reject when total/est < law2.floor.

acts.note: Editorial-skin arc; a two-act contender split (one per corner) or single-act ring both valid. Palettes from a motif pack or per-act tokens.

timing.note: Versus subjects are undated — no event/period timing gate.

signature_moment.note: Law 5: THE Versus signature — the verdict stamp slams at the close of every round. The stitcher stamps mx-sig-stamp-slam on every chapter wrapper whose skeleton_slot is 'round'; the round's .mx-stamp verdict object slams under tier2.

cover.gesture: split-corner type — the two contenders share the cover, divided; never the event poster

chrome.note: Stitcher-owned: one .mx-mast, cover, .mx-actopen per act, .mx-transit per seam, one .mx-plate per chapter, back pill, .mx-footer. Structural events at plan time: n_chapters + n_acts + (n_acts - 1).

slots.notes: Who's in the ring and why this comparison matters now.
CRITERIA-FIRST (Part 7 §3): the judging criteria as a ledger object BEFORE any round — the validator enforces that this chapter precedes every round chapter.

One criterion per round, 3-7 rounds. Each round chapter MUST carry plan field `round_verdict` (the committed one-line call) and plan >=1 ephemera event (the .mx-stamp verdict object the signature slam attaches to).
THE COMMITTED CONDITIONAL VERDICT (Part 7 §3): 'if you are X, buy A; if you are Y, buy B' — carried as plan field `conditional_verdict` and rendered as the closing scorecard/ledger.

killer_features.desc: The criteria chapter must precede every round — criteria-FIRST, not retrofitted.
At least 3 rounds; each closes on a committed verdict.
Every round carries a committed per-round verdict (Part 7 §3).
Versus ships the committed conditional final verdict (Part 7 §3).
The final verdict is a committed conditional, carried in the plan.
